request.style: English, female jazz vocal, warm and soulful, solo voice, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, double bass, mellow, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Many foes have risen up against me
Voices claim there is no help in God
They crowd in on every side I see
But I know the truth in the heart of the Lord

[Chorus]
But you Lord are a shield around me
My glory and the one who lifts my head high
You are the strength when I am weak
My refuge in the dark and the light

[Verse]
I call aloud to the Lord for help
He answers me from his holy mountain
My heart finds rest in His firm grip
The truth that is certain and unshaken

[Chorus]
But you Lord are a shield around me
My glory and the one who lifts my head high
You are the strength when I am weak
My refuge in the dark and the light

[Bridge]
I lie down and sleep in peace
I wake again because He sustains me
I will not fear the thousands around
For His hand holds me securely

[Chorus]
But you Lord are a shield around me
My glory and the one who lifts my head high
You are the strength when I am weak
My refuge in the dark and the light

[Outro]
You are my shield around me
My glory and my head lifted high
